title: Forfeiting Aged Reward Points on a Circle Membership
content:
## How a sweep of a Circle point balance is booked

A sweep of the reward points on a Northbeam Circle Membership takes the oldest live points first, and one
sweep row is booked per sweep year so the forfeiture can be told apart from a redemption.

An expiry sweep is booked only against a membership standing in active, grace or lapsed. The standing
recorded on the membership named is read before the sweep is booked, from the record itself.

## Lapse and reinstatement

A lapse forfeits every live point at once, whatever its age. A reinstatement inside the window restores
only points whose expiry months have not since run out.

## Points already swept

Points already swept are never restored as a courtesy, and a customer who disputes a sweep is shown the
earning dates rather than being granted a fresh balance.

## A clause of this policy no longer in force

The clause giving a point a life of the expiry months of the tier held on the day it was earned, counted
from the end of the calendar month in which it was earned, and sweeping it off at the end of the sweep
month, is **no longer in force**. The expiry months recorded for each tier remain a figure of the tier,
and the sweep order recorded against this policy — oldest live points first — stays in force.

## Points of judgement on the sweep

*Can two sweep rows stand for one sweep year on one membership?* No. One row is booked for each sweep
year on a membership, which is what allows a forfeiture to be told apart from a redemption on the ledger.

*A membership lapsed with 7300 live points and is reinstated inside its window: what comes back?* Only
those of the 7300 points whose expiry months have not run out in the meantime; the rest stay forfeited.

*A membership standing cancelled is put forward for a sweep: may it be booked?* No. A sweep is booked
only against a membership standing in active, grace or lapsed.

superseded_clauses: A point stays live for the expiry months of the tier held on the day it was earned, counted from the end of the calendar month in which it was earned, and is swept off at the end of the sweep month.
